chapters.title: The virtue of remembrance

items.ar: قال الله تعالى:{ فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُواْ لِي وَلاَ تَكْفُرُونِ }
items.text: Allah the Exalted said: «So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not be ungrateful to Me.»
items.src: Surat al-Baqarah, ayah 152

items.ar: { يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ ذِكْراً كَثِيراً}
items.text: «O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance.»
items.src: Surat al-Ahzab, ayah 41

items.ar: { وَالذَّاكِرِينَ اللَّهَ كَثِيراً وَالذَّاكِرَاتِ أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْراً عَظِيماً}
items.text: «And the men who remember Allah often and the women who do so — for them Allah has prepared forgiveness and a great reward.»
items.src: Surat al-Ahzab, ayah 35

items.ar: { وَاذْكُر رَّبَّكَ فِي نَفْسِكَ تَضَرُّعاً وَخِيفَةً وَدُونَ الْجَهْرِ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالآصَالِ وَلاَ تَكُن مِّنَ الْغَافِلِينَ }
items.text: «And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear, without loudness in speech, in the mornings and the evenings, and do not be among the heedless.»
items.src: Surat al-A'raf, ayah 205

items.ar: وقال صلى الله عليه وسلم : مثل الذي يذكر ربه والذي لا يذكر ربه مثل الحي والميت
items.text: And he ﷺ said: «The likeness of the one who remembers his Lord and the one who does not remember his Lord is like that of the living and the dead.»
items.src: al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 11/208; and Muslim with the wording: «The likeness of the house in which Allah is remembered and the house in which Allah is not remembered is like that of the living and the dead», 1/539

items.ar: وقال صلى الله عليه وسلم : ألا أنبئكم بخير أعمالكم ،وأزكاها عند مليككم، وأرفعها في درجاتكم ، وخير لكم من إنفاق الذهب والورق ، وخير لكم من أن تلقوا عدوكم فتضربوا أعناقهم ويضربوا أعناقكم ؟ قالوا بلى .قال : ذكر الله تعالى
items.text: And he ﷺ said: «Shall I not inform you of the best of your deeds, the purest of them with your Sovereign, the highest of them in raising your ranks, better for you than spending gold and silver, and better for you than meeting your enemy and striking their necks while they strike your necks?» They said: «Yes.» He said: «The remembrance of Allah the Exalted.»
items.src: at-Tirmidhi 5/459, Ibn Majah 2/1245; see Sahih Ibn Majah 2/316 and Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/139

items.ar: وقال صلى الله عليه وسلم : يقول الله تعالى : أنا عند ظن عبدي بي ، وأنا معه إذا ذكرني ، فإن ذكرني في نفسه ذكرتهُ في نفسي ، وإن ذكرني في ملأ ذكرته في ملأ خير منهم ،وإن تقرب إلي شبراً تقربت إليه ذراعاً ،وإن تقرب إلي ذراعاً تقربت إليه باعاً ، وإن أتاني يمشي أتيتهُ هرولة
items.text: And he ﷺ said: «Allah the Exalted says: I am as My slave thinks of Me, and I am with him when he remembers Me. If he remembers Me within himself, I remember him within Myself; and if he remembers Me in a gathering, I remember him in a gathering better than them. If he draws near to Me by a hand-span, I draw near to him by a cubit; and if he draws near to Me by a cubit, I draw near to him by an arm's length. And if he comes to Me walking, I come to him running.»
items.src: al-Bukhari 8/171, Muslim 4/2061; the wording is al-Bukhari's

items.ar: وعن عبد الله بن بسرٍ رضي الله عنهُ أن رجلاً قال : يا رسول الله إن شرائع الإسلام قد كثرت علي فأخبرني بشيءٍ أتشبث به. قال صلى الله عليه وسلم : لا يزال لسانك رطباً من ذكر الله
items.text: From 'Abdullah ibn Busr (may Allah be pleased with him) that a man said: «O Messenger of Allah, the laws of Islam have become too many for me, so tell me something I can hold fast to.» He ﷺ said: «Let your tongue not cease to be moist with the remembrance of Allah.»
items.src: at-Tirmidhi 5/458, Ibn Majah 2/1246; see Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/139 and Sahih Ibn Majah 2/317

items.ar: وقال صلى الله عليه وسلم: من قرأ حرفاً من كتاب الله فله به حسنة ،والحسنة بعشر أمثالها ، لا أقول : {الم } حرف؛ ولكن : ألف حرف ،ولام حرف ،وميم حرف
items.text: And he ﷺ said: «Whoever reads a letter from the Book of Allah will have a good deed for it, and a good deed is multiplied tenfold. I do not say that «Alif-Lam-Mim» is one letter; rather, «Alif» is a letter, «Lam» is a letter and «Mim» is a letter.»
items.src: at-Tirmidhi 5/175; see Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/9 and Sahih al-Jami' as-Saghir 5/340

items.ar: وعن عقبة بن عامر رضي الله عنه قال : خرج رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ونحن في الصفة فقال : أيكم يحب أن يغدو كل يوم إلى بطحان أو إلى العقيق فيأتي منه بناقتين كوماوين في غير إثم ولا قطيعة رحم ؟ فقلنا : يا رسول الله نحب ذلك . قال : أفلا يغدو أحدكم إلى المسجد فيعلم ، أو يقرأ آيتين من كتاب الله عز وجل خير له من ناقتين ، وثلاث خير لهُ من ثلاث ٍ، وأربع خير لهُ من أربع ، ومن أعدادهن من الإبل
items.text: From 'Uqbah ibn 'Amir (may Allah be pleased with him), who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out while we were in the Suffah and said: «Which of you would love to go out every morning to Buthan or to al-'Aqiq and bring back from there two large-humped she-camels, without committing a sin or severing ties of kinship?» We said: «O Messenger of Allah, we would love that.» He said: «Then does one of you not go out in the morning to the mosque and learn or recite two ayat from the Book of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic? That is better for him than two she-camels, three are better for him than three, four are better for him than four, and the like of their number in camels.»
items.src: Muslim 1/553

items.ar: وقال صلى الله عليه وسلم: من قعد مقعداً لم يذكر الله فيه كانت عليه من الله ترة ومن اضطجع مضجعاً لم يذكر الله فيه كانت عليه من الله ترة
items.text: And he ﷺ said: «Whoever sits in a sitting in which he does not remember Allah, it will be a loss for him from Allah; and whoever lies down in a place in which he does not remember Allah, it will be a loss for him from Allah.»
items.src: Abu Dawud 4/264 and others; see Sahih al-Jami' 5/342

items.ar: وقال صلى الله عليه وسلم :  ما جلس قوم مجلساً لم يذكروا الله فيه ، ولم يصلوا على نبيهم إلا كان عليهم ترة ، فإن شاء عذبهم وإن شاء غفر لهم
items.text: And he ﷺ said: «No people sit in a gathering in which they do not remember Allah and do not send blessings upon their Prophet except that it will be a loss for them; if He wills He will punish them, and if He wills He will forgive them.»
items.src: at-Tirmidhi; see Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/140

items.ar: وقال صلى الله عليه وسلم : ما من قوم يقومون من مجلس لا يذكرون الله فيه إلا قاموا عن مثل جيفة حمار وكان لهم حسرة
items.text: And he ﷺ said: «No people get up from a gathering in which they did not remember Allah except that they get up from the like of a donkey's carcass, and it will be a cause of regret for them.»
items.src: Abu Dawud 4/264; see Sahih al-Jami' 5/176

chapters.title: Remembrance upon waking up

items.ar: الحَمْدُ لله الذِي أحْيَانا بَعْدَ مَا أمَاتَنَا* وإلَيْهِ النَشُور*
items.text: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after He had caused us to die*, and to Him is the resurrection*.
items.src: * I.e. the figurative death, which is sleep; sleep is called the lesser death.

items.ar: الحَمْدُ لله الذِي عَافَانِي في جَسَدِي ورَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وأَذِنَ لي بِذِكْرهِ
items.text: All praise is for Allah who gave me well-being in my body, returned my soul to me and permitted me to remember Him.
items.src: * The bringing to life after death (the resurrection).

items.ar: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  مَنْ تَعَارَ مِنَ اللَّيْل*  فقال حين يستيقظ : لا إلَهَ إلاَّ الله وحْدَهُ لا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ ولَهُ الحَمْدُ وهُوَ على كلِّ شيءٍ قَدير،سُبْحانَ الله والحَمْدُ لله  ولا إله إلا الله والله أكبر ولا حَولَ ولا قُوةَ إلا بالله العلي العظيم  ثم دعا:  اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لي، غُفِرَ له ، قال الوليد: أو قال:  دعا استُجيبَ لهُ، فإن قام فتوضأَ ثم صَلّى قُبِلَتْ صَلاتُهُ .
items.text: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: «Whoever wakes up at night* and says upon waking: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things competent. Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no might nor power except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Great — and then supplicates: O Allah, forgive me — he will be forgiven.» Al-Walid said: or he said: «...and supplicates, his supplication will be answered. And if he gets up, performs wudu and prays, his prayer will be accepted.»
items.src: al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 11/113, Muslim 4/2083

items.ar: {إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلاَفِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لآيَاتٍ لِّأُوْلِي الألْبَابِ *الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللّهَ قِيَاماً وَقُعُوداً وَعَلَىَ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذا بَاطِلاً سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ*رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ *رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِياً يُنَادِي لِلإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الأبْرَارِ * رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلاَ تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لاَ تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ *فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لاَ أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِّنكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَى بَعْضُكُم مِّن بَعْضٍ فَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ وَأُخْرِجُواْ مِن دِيَارِهِمْ وَأُوذُواْ فِي سَبِيلِي وَقَاتَلُواْ وَقُتِلُواْ لأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ ثَوَاباً مِّن عِندِ اللّهِ وَاللّهُ عِندَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ *لاَ يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي الْبِلاَدِ *مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ *لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْاْ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلاً مِّنْ عِندِ اللّهِ وَمَا عِندَ اللّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّلأَبْرَارِ * وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَن يُؤْمِنُ بِاللّهِ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَاشِعِينَ لِلّهِ لاَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللّهِ ثَمَناً قَلِيلاً أُوْلَـئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِنَّ اللّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ *يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ اصْبِرُواْ وَصَابِرُواْ وَرَابِطُواْ وَاتَّقُواْ اللّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ }
items.text: «Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding — who remember Allah standing, sitting and lying on their sides, and reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth, saying: Our Lord, You did not create this in vain; glory be to You, so protect us from the punishment of the Fire. Our Lord, whoever You admit to the Fire, You have disgraced him, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers. Our Lord, we have heard a caller calling to faith: «Believe in your Lord», and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins, remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous. Our Lord, grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not break Your promise. And their Lord responded to them: Never will I allow the deed of any doer among you to be lost, whether male or female; you are of one another. So those who emigrated, were driven out of their homes, were harmed in My cause, fought and were killed — I will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, as a reward from Allah; and with Allah is the best reward. Do not be deceived by the movement of the disbelievers throughout the land. It is a brief enjoyment; then their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place. But those who fear their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein forever, as hospitality from Allah. And what is with Allah is better for the righteous. And indeed, among the People of the Book are those who believe in Allah and in what was revealed to you and what was revealed to them, humbly submissive to Allah. They do not sell the verses of Allah for a small price. Those will have their reward with their Lord. Indeed, Allah is swift in account. O you who have believed, be patient, outdo others in patience, remain steadfast at your posts and fear Allah, so that you may succeed.»
items.src: at-Tirmidhi 5/473; see Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/144

chapters.title: Supplication when putting on a garment

items.ar: مَنْ لَبِسَ ثَوْباًً فقال: الحَمْدُ لله الذِي كَساني هذا( الثوب ) ورَزَقَنِيه مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنّي ولا قُوةٍ
items.text: Whoever puts on a garment and says: «All praise is for Allah who clothed me with this (garment) and provided it for me without any might or power on my part.»
items.src: Reported by the authors of the Sunan except an-Nasa'i; see Irwa' al-Ghalil 7/47

chapters.title: Supplication when putting on a new garment

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوتَنِيه،أسْألك مِنْ خَيرِهِ وخَيْرَ ما صُنع لَهُ،وأعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شرِّه وشَرَّ ما صُنِعَ لَهُ
items.text: O Allah, to You belongs all praise; You have clothed me with it. I ask You for its good and the good of what it was made for, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of what it was made for.
items.src: Abu Dawud, at-Tirmidhi and al-Baghawi; see al-Albani's Mukhtasar Shama'il at-Tirmidhi, p. 47

chapters.title: Supplication for someone who puts on a new garment

items.ar: إلبِسْ جَدِيداً وعِشْ حميداً ومُتْ شهيداً
items.text: Wear new, live praiseworthy and die a martyr.
items.src: Ibn Majah 2/1178, al-Baghawi 12/41; see Sahih Ibn Majah 2/275

items.ar: تُبْلي ويَخْلِفُ الله تعالى
items.text: Wear it out, and may Allah the Exalted replace it.
items.src: Reported by Abu Dawud 4/41; see Sahih Abu Dawud 2/760

chapters.title: What to say when taking off one's clothes

items.ar: سِتْرُ ما بَيْنَ أعْيُن الجِنِّ وَعَوْرَاتِ بَني آدَمَ إذا وَضَعَ أحدُهُمْ ثَوْبَهُ أنْ يقول:  بِسم الله
items.text: The screen between the eyes of the jinn and the private parts of the children of Adam, when one of them takes off his garment, is that he says: «In the name of Allah.»
items.src: at-Tirmidhi 2/505 and others; see al-Irwa', no. 49, and Sahih al-Jami' 3/203

chapters.title: Supplication when entering the toilet

items.ar: {بسم الله}، اللهُمَّ إنّي أعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الخُبْثِ والخبائِثِ
items.text: (In the name of Allah.) O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female evil ones.
items.src: Reported by al-Bukhari 1/45 and Muslim 1/283; the hadith is agreed upon. The addition of «In the name of Allah» at its beginning was reported by Sa'id ibn Mansur; see Fath al-Bari 1/244

chapters.title: Supplication when leaving the toilet

items.ar: غُفْرانَكَ
items.text: (I ask) Your forgiveness.
items.src: Reported by the authors of the Sunan except an-Nasa'i, who reported it in 'Amal al-Yawm wa'l-Layla; see the takhrij of Zad al-Ma'ad 2/387

chapters.title: Remembrance before wudu

items.ar: بسم الله
items.text: In the name of Allah.
items.src: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah and Ahmad; see Irwa' al-Ghalil 1/122

chapters.title: Remembrance after finishing wudu

items.ar: أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له ، وأشهد أن محمداً عبده ورسوله
items.text: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.
items.src: Reported by Muslim 1/209

items.ar: وزاد الترمذي بعد ذكر الشهادتين :اللهم اجعلني من التوابين واجعلني من المتطهرين
items.text: At-Tirmidhi added after the two testimonies: «O Allah, make me among those who repent much and make me among those who purify themselves.»
items.src: at-Tirmidhi 1/78; see Sahih at-Tirmidhi 1/18

items.ar: سبحانك اللهم وبحمدك أشهد أن لا إله إلا أنت أستغفرك وأتوب إليك
items.text: Glory be to You, O Allah, and with Your praise. I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
items.src: an-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa'l-Layla, p. 173; see Irwa' al-Ghalil 1/135 and 2/94

chapters.title: Remembrance when leaving the house

items.ar: بسم الله ، توكَّلْتُ على الله ، ولا حَوْلَ ولا قُوةَ إلا بالله
items.text: In the name of Allah. I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.
items.src: Abu Dawud 4/325, at-Tirmidhi 5/490; see Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/151

items.ar: اللهُمَ إني أعُوذُ بِكَ أن أَضِلَّ أوْ أُضَلَّ أَوْ أزِلَّ، أو أُزَلَّ، أوْ أظلِم أوْ أُظْلَم، أوْ أَجْهَلَ أوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ
items.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I go astray or be led astray, lest I slip or be made to slip, lest I wrong or be wronged, lest I behave ignorantly or be treated ignorantly.
items.src: The authors of the Sunan; see Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/152 and Sahih Ibn Majah 2/336

chapters.title: Remembrance when entering the house

items.ar: بسم الله ولجنا ،وبسم الله خرجنا ، وعلى ربنا توكلنا ، ثم ليسلم على أهله
items.text: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we rely. Then let him greet his family with salam.
items.src: Reported by Abu Dawud 4/325, and its chain was graded hasan by al-'Allamah Ibn Baz in Tuhfat al-Akhyar, p. 28. In the Sahih: «When a man enters his house and remembers Allah upon entering and upon eating, Shaytan says: There is no lodging for you and no supper.» Muslim, no. 2018

chapters.title: Supplication when going to the mosque

items.ar: اللهم اجعل في قلبي نوراً ، وفي لساني نوراً ، وفي سمعي نوراً ، وفي بصري نوراً ، ومن فوقي نوراً ، ومن تحتي نوراً ، وعن يميني نوراً ، وعن شمالي نوراً ، ومن أمامي نوراً ، ومن خلفي نوراً  ، و اجعل في نفسي نوراً ، وأعظم لي نوراً ، وعظم لي نوراً ، واجعل لي نوراً ، واجعلني نوراً ، اللهم أعطني نوراً ، واجعل في عصبي نوراً ، وفي لحمي نوراً ، وفي دمي نوراً ، وفي شعري نوراً ، وفي بشري نوراً
items.text: O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my tongue, light in my hearing, light in my sight, light above me, light below me, light on my right, light on my left, light in front of me and light behind me; place light in my soul, magnify light for me, make light great for me, grant me light and make me light. O Allah, give me light, and place light in my sinews, light in my flesh, light in my blood, light in my hair and light in my skin.
items.src: All of these phrases are in al-Bukhari 11/116, no. 6316, and Muslim 1/526, 529, 530, no. 763

items.ar: اللهم اجعل لي نوراً في قبري .. ونوراً في عظامي
items.text: O Allah, grant me light in my grave... and light in my bones.
items.src: at-Tirmidhi, no. 3419, 5/483

items.ar: وزدني نوراً ، وزدني نوراً ، وزدني نوراً
items.text: And increase me in light, increase me in light, increase me in light.
items.src: Reported by al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad, no. 695, p. 258; al-Albani graded its chain sahih in Sahih al-Adab al-Mufrad, no. 536

items.ar: وهب لي نوراً على نوراً
items.text: And grant me light upon light.
items.src: Mentioned by Ibn Hajar in Fath al-Bari, attributing it to Ibn Abi 'Asim in Kitab ad-Du'a; see al-Fath 11/118. He said: «From the different narrations, twenty-five phrases are gathered»

chapters.title: Supplication when entering the mosque

items.ar: أعوذ بالله العظيم ،وبوجهه الكريم ،وسلطانه القديم ،من الشيطان الرجيم
items.text: I seek refuge in Allah the Magnificent, in His Noble Face and in His eternal authority from Shaytan the accursed.
items.src: Abu Dawud; see Sahih al-Jami', no. 4591

items.ar: [ بسم الله ،والصلاة ] [ والسلام على رسول الله] ، اللهم افتح لي أبواب رحمتك
items.text: [In the name of Allah, and blessings] [and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah.] O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.
items.src: Reported by Ibn as-Sunni, no. 88, and graded hasan by al-Albani

chapters.title: Supplication when leaving the mosque

items.ar: بسم الله والصلاة والسلام على رسول الله ،اللهم إني أسألك من فضلك، اللهم اعصمني من الشيطان الرجيم
items.text: In the name of Allah, and blessings and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty. O Allah, protect me from Shaytan the accursed.
items.src: See the takhrij of the narrations of the previous hadith, no. 20. The addition «O Allah, protect me from Shaytan the accursed» is from Ibn Majah. See Sahih Ibn Majah 1/288

chapters.title: Remembrance during the adhan

items.ar: يقول مثل ما يقول المؤذن إلا في حي على الصلاة ، وحي على الفلاح فيقول لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
items.text: He says the same as the mu'adhdhin says, except at «Hayya 'ala's-salah» and «Hayya 'ala'l-falah», where he says: «There is no might nor power except with Allah.»
items.src: al-Bukhari 1/152, Muslim 1/288

items.ar: يقول  وأنا أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله ، وحده لا شريك له ، وأن محمد عبده ورسوله ، رضيت بالله رباً ، وبمحمداً رسولاً وبالإسلام ديناً (( يقول ذلك عقب تشهد المؤذن))
items.text: He says: «And I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Muhammad as Messenger and with Islam as religion.» (He says this after the mu'adhdhin's testimony.)
items.src: Muslim 1/290

items.ar: يصلي على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بعد فراغه من إجابة المؤذن
items.text: He sends blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ after finishing responding to the mu'adhdhin.
items.src: Ibn Khuzaymah 1/220

items.ar: اللهم رب هذه الدعوة التامة ،والصلاة القائمة، آت محمداً الوسيلة والفضيلة، وأبعثه مقاماً محموداً الذي وعدته، [ إنك لا تخلف الميعاد ]
items.text: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the prayer about to be established, grant Muhammad al-wasilah and al-fadilah, and raise him to the praised station that You have promised him. [Indeed, You do not break Your promise.]
items.src: Muslim 1/288

items.ar: يدعو لنفسه بين الأذان والإقامة فإن الدعاء حينئذٍ لا يرد
items.text: He supplicates for himself between the adhan and the iqamah, for supplication at that time is not rejected.
items.src: al-Bukhari 1/152; what is between the square brackets is from al-Bayhaqi 1/410, and its chain was graded hasan by al-'Allamah 'Abd al-'Aziz ibn Baz in Tuhfat al-Akhyar, p. 38

chapters.title: The opening supplication of the prayer

items.ar: اللهم باعد بيني وبين خطاياي كما باعدت بين المشرق والمغرب ، اللهم نقني من خطاياي كما ينقى الثوب الأبيض من الدنس اللهم اغسلني من خطاياي بالماء والثلج والبرد
items.text: O Allah, distance me from my sins as You have distanced the east from the west. O Allah, cleanse me of my sins as a white garment is cleansed of dirt. O Allah, wash me of my sins with water, snow and hail.
items.src: al-Bukhari 1/181, Muslim 1/419

items.ar: سبحانك اللهم وبحمد ك وتبارك اسمك وتعالى جدك، ولا أ له غيرك
items.text: Glory be to You, O Allah, and with Your praise. Blessed is Your Name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god other than You.
items.src: Reported by the four authors of the Sunan; see Sahih at-Tirmidhi 1/77 and Sahih Ibn Majah 1/135

items.ar: وجهت وجهي للذي فطر السموات والأرض حنيفاً وما أنا من المشركين ،إن صلاتي ونُسُكي ومحياي ومماتي لله رب العالمين ، لا شريك له وبذلك أمرت وأنا من المسلمين اللهم أنت الملك لا إله إلا أنت ، أنت ربي وأنا عبدك ، ظلمت نفسي ، واعترفت بذنبي ، فاغفر لي ذنوبي جميعاً ، إنه لا يغفر الذنوب إلا أنت ، واهدني لأحسن الأخلاق، لا يهدي لأحسنها إلا أنت ، واصرف عني سيئها لا يصرف عني سيئها إلا أنت لبيك وسعديك والخير كله بيديك ، والشر ليس إليك ، أنا بك وإليك ، تباركت وتعاليت أستغفرك وأتوب إليك
items.text: I have turned my face, as a monotheist, to the One who created the heavens and the earth, and I am not of the polytheists. Indeed, my prayer, my sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds; He has no partner. With this I have been commanded, and I am of the Muslims. O Allah, You are the King; there is no god but You. You are my Lord and I am Your slave. I have wronged myself and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me all my sins, for none forgives sins but You. Guide me to the best of manners, for none guides to the best of them but You, and turn away from me their bad, for none turns away their bad from me but You. Here I am at Your service and at Your call; all good is in Your hands, and evil is not attributed to You. I am by You and to You. Blessed are You and exalted. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
items.src: Reported by Muslim 1/534

items.ar: اللهم رب جبرائيل وميكائيل وإسرافيل ، فاطر السموات والأرض ، عالم الغيب والشهادة ، أنت تحكم بين عبادك فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون اهدني لما اختلف فيه من الحق بإذنك إنك تهدي من تشاء إلى صراط مستقيم
items.text: O Allah, Lord of Jibril, Mika'il and Israfil, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You judge between Your slaves concerning that wherein they used to differ. Guide me, by Your permission, to the truth in that over which there has been difference; indeed You guide whom You will to a straight path.
items.src: Reported by Muslim 1/534

items.ar: الله اكبر كبيرا، الله اكبر كبيرا، الله اكبر كبيرا، والحمد لله كثيرا، والحمد لله كثيرا، والحمد لله كثيرا، وسبحان الله بكرةً وأصيلا ـ ثلاثا ـ  أعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم : من نفخه، ونفثه ،و همزه
items.text: Allah is the Greatest, very great; Allah is the Greatest, very great; Allah is the Greatest, very great. Much praise be to Allah, much praise be to Allah, much praise be to Allah. Glory be to Allah morning and evening — three times. I seek refuge in Allah from Shaytan the accursed: from his puffing, his spitting and his prodding.
items.src: Reported by Abu Dawud 1/203, Ibn Majah 1/265 and Ahmad 4/85; Muslim reported something similar from Ibn 'Umar (may Allah be pleased with them both), with a story, 1/420

items.ar: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا قام من الليل يتهجد قال:  اللهم لك الحمد أنت نور السموات والأرض ومن فيهن ، ولك الحمد أنت قيمُ السموات والأرض ومن فيهن [ ولك الحمد أنت رب السموات والأرض ومن فيهن ]، [ ولك الحمد لك ملك السموات والأرض ومن فيهن ] [ ولك الحمد أنت ملك السموات والأرض] [ ولك الحمد] أنت الحق ، ووعدك الحق ، وقولك الحق ،ولقاؤك الحق ، والجنة حق ، والنار حق ، والنبيّون حق ومحمد صلى الله عليه وسلم حق والساعة حق ] [اللهم لك أسلمت ،  وعليك توكلت ، وبك آمنت ، وإليك أنبت ، وبك خاصمت ، وإليك حاكمت ، فاغفر لي ما قدمت وما أخرت ، وأسررت، وما أعلنت ] [ أنت المقدم ،وأنت المؤخر لا إله إلا أنت ] [أنت إلهي لا إله إلا أنت]
items.text: When the Prophet ﷺ got up at night to pray tahajjud, he would say: «O Allah, to You belongs all praise; You are the Light of the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them. To You belongs all praise; You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them. [To You belongs all praise; You are the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them.] [To You belongs all praise; Yours is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them.] [To You belongs all praise; You are the King of the heavens and the earth.] [To You belongs all praise.] You are the Truth, Your promise is true, Your word is true, the meeting with You is true, Paradise is true, the Fire is true, the prophets are true, Muhammad ﷺ is true and the Hour is true.] [O Allah, to You I have submitted, upon You I rely, in You I believe, to You I turn in repentance, by You I dispute and to You I refer for judgement. So forgive me what I have done before and what I have left for later, what I have concealed and what I have done openly.] [You are the One who brings forward and You are the One who puts back; there is no god but You.] [You are my God; there is no god but You.]»
items.src: al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 3/3, 11/116, 13/371, 423, 465; and Muslim, in abridged form, something similar, 1/532

chapters.title: Supplication during ruku'

items.ar: سبحان ربي العظيم  ثلاث مرات
items.text: Glory be to my Lord, the Magnificent — three times.
items.src: Reported by the authors of the Sunan and Ahmad; see Sahih at-Tirmidhi 1/83

items.ar: سبحانك اللهم ربنا وبحمدك ، اللهم اغفر لي
items.text: Glory be to You, O Allah, our Lord, and with Your praise. O Allah, forgive me.
items.src: al-Bukhari 1/199, Muslim 1/350

items.ar: سبوح قدوس رب الملائكة والروح
items.text: Perfect and Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
items.src: Muslim 1/353, Abu Dawud 1/230

items.ar: اللهم لك ركعت وبك آمنت ،ولك أسلمت خشع لك سمعي وبصري ودمي ولحمي وعظمي وعصبي،وما استقل به قدمي
items.text: O Allah, to You I have bowed, in You I believe and to You I have submitted. My hearing, my sight, my blood, my flesh, my bones, my sinews and whatever my feet carry are humbled before You.
items.src: Muslim 1/534, and the four (authors of the Sunan) except Ibn Majah

items.ar: سبحان ذي الجبروت والملكوت والكبرياء والعظمة
items.text: Glory be to the Possessor of might, dominion, grandeur and magnificence.
items.src: Abu Dawud 1/230, an-Nasa'i and Ahmad; its chain is hasan

chapters.title: Supplication when rising from ruku'

items.ar: سمع الله لمن حمده
items.text: Allah hears the one who praises Him.
items.src: al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 2/282

items.ar: ربنا ولك الحمد ، حمداً كثيراً طيباً مباركاً فيه
items.text: Our Lord, and to You belongs all praise — abundant, good and blessed praise.
items.src: al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 2/282

items.ar: ....ملء السموات وملء الأرض وما بينهما ، وملء ما شئت من شئ بعد .أهل الثناء والمجد،أحق ما قال العبد، وكلنا لك عبد ، اللهم لا مانع لما أعطيت ولا معطي لما منعت ولا ينفع ذا الجد منك الجد
items.text: ...filling the heavens, filling the earth and what is between them, and filling whatever else You will. O Possessor of praise and glory, the truest thing a slave has said — and we are all Your slaves: O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and the wealth of a wealthy person does not avail him against You.
items.src: Muslim 1/346

chapters.title: Supplication during prostration

items.ar: سبحان ربي الأعلى  ، ثلاث مرات .
items.text: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High — three times.
items.src: Reported by the authors of the Sunan and Ahmad; see Sahih at-Tirmidhi 1/83

items.ar: سبحانك اللهم ربنا وبحمدك ، اللهم اغفر لي
items.text: Glory be to You, O Allah, our Lord, and with Your praise. O Allah, forgive me.
items.src: al-Bukhari and Muslim; its takhrij preceded under no. 34

items.ar: سبوح قدوس رب الملائكة والروح
items.text: Perfect and Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
items.src: Muslim 1/533; it preceded under no. 35

items.ar: اللهم لك سجدت وبك آمنت ولك أسلمت،سجد وجهي للذي خلقه وصوره وشق سمعه وبصره تبارك الله أحسن الخالقين
items.text: O Allah, to You I have prostrated, in You I believe and to You I have submitted. My face has prostrated to the One who created it, shaped it and opened its hearing and sight. Blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
items.src: Muslim 1/534 and others

items.ar: سبحان ذي الجبروت والملكوت ، والكبرياء والعظمة
items.text: Glory be to the Possessor of might, dominion, grandeur and magnificence.
items.src: Abu Dawud 1/230, an-Nasa'i and Ahmad; al-Albani graded it sahih in Sahih Abu Dawud, 166

items.ar: اللهم اغفر لي ذنبي كله ، دقه وجله ،وأوله وآخره ،وعلانيته وسره
items.text: O Allah, forgive me all my sins: the small and the great, the first and the last, the open and the secret.
items.src: Muslim 1/350

items.ar: اللهم إني أعوذ برضاك من سخطك وبمعافاتك من عقوبتك،وأعوذ بك منك لا أحصي ثناء عليك أنت كما أثنيت على نفسك
items.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your anger, and in Your pardon from Your punishment, and I seek refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise; You are as You have praised Yourself.
items.src: Muslim 1/352

chapters.title: Supplication while sitting between the two prostrations

items.ar: رب اغفر لي ، رب اغفر لي
items.text: My Lord, forgive me. My Lord, forgive me.
items.src: Abu Dawud 1/231; see Sahih Ibn Majah 1/148

items.ar: اللهم اغفر لي ، وارحمني ،واهدني ، واجبرني،  وعافني،وارزقني ، وارفعني
items.text: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, mend my state, grant me well-being, provide for me and raise me.
items.src: Reported by the authors of the Sunan except an-Nasa'i; see Sahih at-Tirmidhi 1/90 and Sahih Ibn Majah 1/148

chapters.title: Supplication for the prostration of recitation

items.ar: سجد وجهي للذي خلقه ، وشق سمعه وبصره بحوله وقوته { فتبارك الله أحسن الخالقين }
items.text: My face has prostrated to the One who created it and opened its hearing and sight by His might and power. «So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.»
items.src: at-Tirmidhi 2/474, Ahmad 6/30 and al-Hakim, who graded it sahih, and adh-Dhahabi agreed with him, 1/220; the addition is his

items.ar: اللهم أكتب لي بها عندك أجراً ، وضع عني بها وزراً ، واجعلها لي عندك ذخراً ، وتقبلها مني كما تقبلتها من عبدك داود
items.text: O Allah, record for me by it a reward with You, remove from me by it a burden of sin, make it a treasure for me with You, and accept it from me as You accepted it from Your slave Dawud.
items.src: at-Tirmidhi 2/473 and al-Hakim, who graded it sahih, and adh-Dhahabi agreed with him, 1/219

chapters.title: The tashahhud

items.ar: التحيات لله ، والصلوات ، والطيبات ، السلام عليك أيها النبي ورحمة الله وبركاته ، السلام علينا وعلى عباد الله الصالحين ،أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله ، وأشهد أن محمداً عبده ورسوله
items.text: All greetings are for Allah, and all prayers and all good things. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous slaves of Allah. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.
items.src: al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 1/13, Muslim 1/301

chapters.title: Sending blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ after the tashahhud
chapters.titleAr: الصلاة على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بعد التشهد

items.ar: اللهم صل على محمد وعلى آل محمد ، كما صليت على  إبراهيم ، وعلى آل إبراهيم ، إنك حميد مجيد ، اللهم بارك على محمد وعلى آل محمد كما باركت على إبراهيم ، وعلى آل إبراهيم إنك حميد مجيد
items.text: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
items.src: al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 6/408

items.ar: اللهم صل على محمد وعلى أزواجه وذريته،كما صليت على آل إبراهيم، وبارك على محمد وعلى أزواجه وذريته كما باركت على آل إبراهيم إنك حميد مجيد
items.text: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, his wives and his offspring, as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibrahim; and bless Muhammad, his wives and his offspring, as You blessed the family of Ibrahim; indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
items.src: al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 6/407 and Muslim 1/306; the wording is Muslim's

chapters.title: Supplication after the final tashahhud and before the salam
chapters.titleAr: الدعاء بعد التشهد الأخير وقبل السلام

items.ar: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من عذاب القبر،ومن عذاب جهنم،ومن فتنة المحيا والممات ،ومن شر فتنة المسيح الدجال
items.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the punishment of Hell, from the trial of life and death, and from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah (al-Masih ad-Dajjal).
items.src: al-Bukhari 2/102, Muslim 1/412; the wording is Muslim's

items.ar: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من عذاب القبر،وأعوذ بك من فتنة المسيح الدجال،وأعوذ بك من فتنة المحيا والممات، اللهم إني أعوذ بك من المأثم والمغرم
items.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, I seek refuge in You from the trial of the False Messiah, and I seek refuge in You from the trial of life and death. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and from debt.
items.src: al-Bukhari 1/202, Muslim 1/412

items.ar: اللهم إني ظلمت نفسي ظلماً كثيراً ، ولا يغفر الذنوب إلا أنت ، فاغفر لي مغفرة من عندك وارحمني إنك أنت الغفور الرحيم
items.text: O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly, and none forgives sins but You, so forgive me with forgiveness from You and have mercy on me; indeed You are the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
items.src: al-Bukhari 8/168, Muslim 4/2078

items.ar: اللهم اغفر لي ما قدمت وما أخرت وما أسررت وما أعلنت وما أسرفت وما أنت أعلم به مني أنت المقدم وأنت المؤخر لا إله إلا أنت
items.text: O Allah, forgive me what I have done before and what I have left for later, what I have concealed and what I have done openly, what I have done in excess, and what You know better than I. You are the One who brings forward and You are the One who puts back; there is no god but You.
items.src: Muslim 1/534

items.ar: اللهم أعني على ذكرك ، وشكرك وحسن عبادتك
items.text: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You and to worship You in the best manner.
items.src: Abu Dawud 2/86, an-Nasa'i 3/53; al-Albani graded it sahih in Sahih Abu Dawud 1/284

items.ar: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من البخل وأعوذ بك من الجبن ، وأعوذ بك من أن أرد إلى أرذل العمر ، وأعوذ بك من فتنة الدنيا وأعوذ بك من عذاب القبر
items.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from miserliness, I seek refuge in You from cowardice, I seek refuge in You from being returned to the most decrepit old age, I seek refuge in You from the trial of this world, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave.
items.src: al-Bukhari 6/35

items.ar: اللهم إني أسألك الجنة وأعوذ بك من النار
items.text: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I seek refuge in You from the Fire.
items.src: Abu Dawud; see Sahih Ibn Majah 2/328

items.ar: اللهم بعلمك الغيب وقدرتك على الخلق أحيني ما علمت الحياة خيراً لي وتوفني إذا علمت الوفاة خيراً لي ، اللهم إني أسألك خشيتك في الغيب والشهادة ، وأسألك كلمة الحق في الرضا والغضب ، وأسألك القصد في الغنى والفقر ، وأسألك نعيماً لا ينفد ، وأسألك قرة عين لا تنقطع ، وأسألك الرضا بعد القضاء ، وأسألك برد العيش بعد الموت ، وأسألك لذة النظر إلى وجهك والشوق إلى لقائك من غير ضرَّاء مضرة ولا فتنة مضلة ، اللهم زينا بزينة الإيمان ، واجعلنا هداة مهتدين
items.text: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive as long as You know life to be better for me, and take me when You know death to be better for me. O Allah, I ask You for fear of You in private and in public. I ask You for the word of truth in contentment and in anger. I ask You for moderation in wealth and in poverty. I ask You for bliss that does not run out. I ask You for delight of the eye that does not cease. I ask You for contentment after the decree. I ask You for a pleasant life after death. And I ask You for the delight of looking at Your Face and longing to meet You, without harmful affliction or misleading trial. O Allah, adorn us with the adornment of faith and make us guides who are rightly guided.
items.src: an-Nasa'i 4/54, 55 and Ahmad 4/364; al-Albani graded it sahih in Sahih an-Nasa'i 1/281

items.ar: اللهم إني أسألك يا الله بأنك الواحد الأحد الصمد الذي لم يلد ولم يولد ولم يكن له كفواً أحد أن تغفر لي ذنوبي إنك أنت الغفور الرحيم
items.text: O Allah, I ask You, O Allah, by Your being the One, the Unique, as-Samad, who neither begets nor was begotten, and to whom no one is equal, that You forgive me my sins; indeed You are the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
items.src: Reported by an-Nasa'i with this wording, 3/52, and Ahmad 4/338; al-Albani graded it sahih in Sahih an-Nasa'i 1/280

items.ar: اللهم إني أسألك بأن لك الحمد ، لا إله إلا أنت وحدك لا شريك لك ، المنان ، يا بديع السموات والأرض يا ذا الجلال والإكرام يا حي يا قيوم إني أسألك الجنة وأعوذ بك من النار
items.text: O Allah, I ask You by the fact that to You belongs all praise; there is no god but You alone, without partner; the Bestower of favours. O Originator of the heavens and the earth, O Possessor of majesty and honour, O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, I ask You for Paradise and I seek refuge in You from the Fire.
items.src: Reported by the authors of the Sunan; see Sahih Ibn Majah 2/329

items.ar: اللهم إني أسألك بأني أشهد أنك أنت الله لا إله إلا أنت،الأحد الصمد الذي لم يلد ولم يولد ولم يكن له كفواً أحد
items.text: O Allah, I ask You by my bearing witness that You are Allah; there is no god but You, the One, as-Samad, who neither begets nor was begotten, and to whom no one is equal.
items.src: Abu Dawud 2/62, at-Tirmidhi 5/515, Ibn Majah 2/1267, Ahmad 5/360; see Sahih Ibn Majah 2/329 and Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/163

chapters.title: Remembrance after the salam of the prayer

items.ar: أستغفر الله  ثلاثاً .. اللهم أنت السلام ، ومنك السلام ، تباركت يا ذا الجلال والإكرام
items.text: I seek Allah's forgiveness (three times). O Allah, You are as-Salam, and from You is peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.
items.src: Muslim 1/414

items.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
items.text: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things competent. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and the wealth of a wealthy person does not avail him against You.
items.src: al-Bukhari 1/255, Muslim 1/414

items.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له،له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شئ قدير،لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله،لا إله إلا الله،ولا نعبد إلا إياه ، له النعمة وله الفضل ،وله الثناء الحسن،لا إله إلا الله مخلصين له الدين ولو كره الكافرون
items.text: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things competent. There is no might nor power except with Allah. There is no god but Allah, and we worship none but Him. His is the favour, His is the bounty and His is the excellent praise. There is no god but Allah; we are sincere to Him in religion, even though the disbelievers dislike it.
items.src: Muslim 1/415

items.ar: سبحان الله ، والحمد لله ، والله أكبر ( ثلاثاً وثلاثين ) لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له ، له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير
items.text: Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, and Allah is the Greatest (thirty-three times). There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things competent.
items.src: Muslim 1/418. Whoever says that after every prayer, his sins will be forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea. Muslim 1/418

items.ar: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم{ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ*اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ*لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ * وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ} بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم {قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ * مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ *وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ * وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ * وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ } بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم{ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ * مَلِكِ النَّاسِ * إِلَهِ النَّاسِ *مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ * الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ * مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ }بعد كل صلاة مرة واحدة , وبعد صلاة المغرب والفجر ثلاث مرات
items.text: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. «Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, as-Samad (the Self-Sufficient Master upon whom all depend). He neither begets nor was He begotten, and there is none equal to Him.» In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. «Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, from the evil of darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.» In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. «Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer, who whispers in the breasts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind.» Once after every prayer, and three times after the Maghrib and Fajr prayers.
items.src: Abu Dawud 2/86, an-Nasa'i 3/68; see Sahih at-Tirmidhi 2/8. These three surahs are called al-Mu'awwidhat; see Fath al-Bari 9/62

items.ar: { اللّهُ لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ }عقب كل صلاة
items.text: «Allah — there is no god except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and guarding them does not tire Him. And He is the Most High, the Magnificent.» After every prayer.
items.src: Whoever recites it after every prayer, nothing prevents him from entering Paradise except death. An-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa'l-Layla, no. 100, and Ibn as-Sunni, no. 121; graded sahih in Sahih al-Jami' 5/339 and Silsilat al-Ahadith as-Sahihah 2/697, no. 972

items.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له ، له الملك وله الحمد ، يحيي ويميت وهو على كل شئ قدير  عشر مرات بعد صلاة المغرب والصبح
items.text: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise; He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent — ten times after the Maghrib and Fajr prayers.
items.src: Reported by at-Tirmidhi 5/515 and Ahmad 4/227; see its takhrij in Zad al-Ma'ad 1/300

items.ar: اللهم إني أسألك علماً نافعاً ، ورزقاً طيباً ، وعملاً متقبلاً بعد السلام من صلاة الفجر
items.text: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision and accepted deeds — after the salam of the Fajr prayer.
items.src: Ibn Majah and others; see Sahih Ibn Majah 1/152 and Majma' az-Zawa'id 10/111

chapters.title: Supplication for the prayer of seeking guidance (istikhara)

items.ar: قال جابر بن عبد الله رضي الله عنهما : كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، يُعلمنا الاستخارة في الأمور كلها كما يعلمُنا السورة من القرآن ، يقول : إذا هم أحدكم بالأمر فليركع ركعتين من غير الفريضة ، ثم ليقل : اللهم إني أستخيرك بعلمك ، وأستقدرك بقدرتك ، وأسألك من فضلك العظيم فإنك تقدِرُ ولا أقدِرُ ، وتعلم ولا أعلم ، وأنت علام الغيوب ، اللهم إن كنت تعلم أن هذا الأمر -يسمي حاجته خير لي في ديني ومعاشي وعاقبة أمري أو قال : عاجلة وآجله فاقدره لي ويسره لي ، ثم بارك لي فيه ، وإن كنت تعلم أن هذا الأمر شر لي في ديني ومعاشي وعاقبة أمري أو قال : عاجله وآجله فاصرفه عني واصرفني عنه ، واقدر لي الخير حيث كان ، ثم ارضني به
items.text: Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to teach us istikhara in all matters, just as he would teach us a surah of the Qur'an. He would say: «When one of you intends to do something, let him pray two rak'ahs other than the obligatory prayer, and then say: O Allah, I seek Your guidance through Your knowledge, I seek ability through Your power, and I ask You of Your great bounty. For You are able and I am not able, You know and I do not know, and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know that this matter — and he names his need — is good for me in my religion, my livelihood and the outcome of my affairs» — or he said: «in my immediate and later affairs» — «then decree it for me, make it easy for me, and then bless me in it. And if You know that this matter is bad for me in my religion, my livelihood and the outcome of my affairs» — or he said: «in my immediate and later affairs» — «then turn it away from me and turn me away from it, decree for me the good wherever it may be, and then make me pleased with it.»
items.src: al-Bukhari 7/162

items.ar: وما ندم من استخار الخالق ، وشاور المخلوقين المؤمنين وتثبت في أمره ، فقد قال سبحانه{ وَشَاوِرْهُمْ فِي الأَمْرِ فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللّهِ}
items.text: Whoever seeks guidance from the Creator, consults believing created beings and is careful in his affair will not regret it, for He, glorified is He, has said: «And consult them in the matter; and when you have decided, then rely upon Allah.»
items.src: Surat Al 'Imran, ayah 159

chapters.title: Morning and evening remembrance

items.ar: الحمد لله وحده ، والصلاة والسلام على من لا نبي بعده
items.text: All praise is for Allah alone, and blessings and peace be upon the one after whom there is no prophet.
items.src: From Anas, attributing it to the Prophet: «That I sit with people remembering Allah the Exalted from the Fajr prayer until the sun rises is more beloved to me than freeing four of the descendants of Isma'il; and that I sit with people remembering Allah from the 'Asr prayer until the sun sets is more beloved to me than freeing four.» Abu Dawud, no. 3667; graded hasan by al-Albani, Sahih Abu Dawud 2/698

items.ar: أعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم { اللّهُ لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ }
items.text: I seek refuge in Allah from Shaytan the accursed. «Allah — there is no god except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and guarding them does not tire Him. And He is the Most High, the Magnificent.»
items.src: Surat al-Baqarah, ayah 255. Whoever says it in the evening is protected from them until morning. Reported by al-Hakim 1/562; al-Albani graded it sahih in Sahih at-Targhib wa't-Tarhib 1/273, attributed it to an-Nasa'i and at-Tabarani, and said: «The chain of at-Tabarani is good»

items.ar: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم{ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ*اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ*لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ * وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ} بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم {قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ * مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ *وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ * وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ * وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ } بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم{ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ * مَلِكِ النَّاسِ * إِلَهِ النَّاسِ *مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ * الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ * مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ }( ثلاث مرات )
items.text: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. «Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, as-Samad (the Self-Sufficient Master upon whom all depend). He neither begets nor was He begotten, and there is none equal to Him.» In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. «Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, from the evil of darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.» In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. «Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer, who whispers in the breasts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind.» (three times)
items.src: Whoever says them three times in the morning and in the evening, they will suffice him against everything. Abu Dawud 4/322, at-Tirmidhi 5/567; see Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/182

items.ar: أصبحنا وأصبح الملك لله ، والحمد لله، لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير، ربِّ أسألك خير ما في هذا اليوم وخير ما بعده  وأعوذ بك من شر ما في هذا اليوم وشر ما بعده ربِّ أعوذ بك من الكسل وسوء الكبر، ربَّ أعوذ بك من عذابٍ في النار وعذاب في القبر  وإذا أمسي قال ذلك أيضا :  أمسينا وأمسي الملك لله .
items.text: We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things competent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evil of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from a punishment in the Fire and a punishment in the grave. And in the evening he says this as well: «We have entered the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah.»
items.src: And in the evening he says: «We have entered the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah»

items.ar: اللهم بك أصبحنا وبك أمسينا  وبك نحيا وبك نموت وإليك النشور    وإذا أمسي فليقل :  اللهم بك أمسينا، وبك أصبحنا، وبك نحيا وبك نموت، وإليك المصير .
items.text: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection. And in the evening let him say: «O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the final return.»
items.src: And in the evening he says: «My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it»

items.ar: اللهم أنت ربي لا إله إلا أنت خَلَقتني وأنا عَبْدُك وأنا على عهدك ووعدك ما استطعت أعوذ بك من شر ما صنعت أبوء  لك بنعمتك علي وأبوء بذنبي فاغفر لي فإنه لا يغفر الذنوب إلا أنت
items.text: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your slave, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as much as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.
items.src: Muslim 4/2088

items.ar: اللهم إني أصبحت  أشهدك وأشهد حملة عرشك ، وملائكتك وجميع خلقك ، أنك أنت الله لا إله إلا أنت وحدك لا شريك لك ، وأن محمداً عبدك ورسولك ( أربع مرات )
items.text: O Allah, I have entered the morning calling You to witness, and calling to witness the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels and all Your creation, that You are Allah; there is no god but You alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is Your slave and Messenger. (four times)
items.src: And in the evening he says: «O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the final return»

items.ar: اللهم ما أصبح بي من نعمة أو بأحد من خلقك فمنك وحدك لا شريك لك ، فلك الحمد ولك الشكر
items.text: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me or to any of Your creation this morning is from You alone, without partner, so to You belongs all praise and to You belongs all thanks.
items.src: at-Tirmidhi 5/466; see Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/142

items.ar: اللهم عافني في بَدَني، اللهم عافني في سمعي، اللهم عافني في بصري، لا إله إلا أنت .اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الكفر، والفقر، اللهم إني أعوذ بك من عذاب القبر لا إله إلا أنت ( ثلاث مرات )
items.text: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O Allah, grant me well-being in my hearing. O Allah, grant me well-being in my sight. There is no god but You. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. There is no god but You. (three times)
items.src: I affirm and I acknowledge

items.ar: حسبي الله لا إله إلا هو عليه توكلت وهو رب العرش العظيم (سبع مرات )
items.text: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but He. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Magnificent Throne. (seven times)
items.src: Whoever says it with certainty in the evening and dies that night will enter Paradise, and likewise if he says it in the morning. Reported by al-Bukhari 7/150

items.ar: اللهم إني أسألك العفو والعافية في الدنيا والآخرة، اللهم إني أسألك العفو والعافية في ديني ودنياي وأهلي ومالي،اللهم استر عوراتي وآمن روعاتي، اللهم احفظني من بين يديَّ ومن خلفي وعن يميني وعن شمالي ومن فوقي وأعوذ بعظمتك أن أغتال من تحتي
items.text: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from in front of me, from behind me, from my right, from my left and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your magnificence from being taken unawares from beneath me.
items.src: And in the evening he says: «O Allah, I have entered the evening...»

items.ar: اللهم عَالِمَ الغيب والشَّهادة، فاطر السموات والأرض، رب كل شيء ومليكه، أشهد أن لا إله إلا أنت أعوذ بك من شر نفسي ومن شر الشيطان وشركه وأن اقترف على نفسي سوءًا أو أجُره إلى مسلم
items.text: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul, from the evil of Shaytan and his shirk, and from committing evil against myself or bringing it upon a Muslim.
items.src: Whoever says it four times in the morning and in the evening, Allah will free him from the Fire. Reported by Abu Dawud 4/317, al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad, no. 1201, an-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa'l-Layla, no. 9, and Ibn as-Sunni, no. 70; His Eminence Shaykh Ibn Baz graded the chain of an-Nasa'i and Abu Dawud hasan in Tuhfat al-Akhyar, p. 23

items.ar: بسم الله الذي لا يضرُّ مع اسمه شيء في الأرض ولا في السماء وهو السميع العليم  ( ثلاث مرات )
items.text: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. (three times)
items.src: And in the evening he says: «O Allah, whatever has come to me this evening...»

items.ar: رضيت بالله رباً ، وبالإسلام ديناً وبمحمد صلى الله عليه وسلم نبياً  ( ثلاث مرات )
items.text: I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Islam as religion and with Muhammad ﷺ as Prophet. (three times)
items.src: Whoever says it in the morning has fulfilled the gratitude due for his day, and whoever says it in the evening has fulfilled the gratitude due for his night. Reported by Abu Dawud 4/318, an-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa'l-Layla, no. 7, Ibn as-Sunni, no. 41, and Ibn Hibban («Mawarid»), no. 2361; Ibn Baz graded its chain hasan in Tuhfat al-Akhyar, p. 24

items.ar: يا حي يا قيوم برحمتك أستغيث أصلح لي شأني كُله ولا تَكِلْني إلى نفسي طرفة عين
items.text: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, by Your mercy I seek help. Set right all my affairs for me and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
items.src: Abu Dawud 4/324, Ahmad 5/42, an-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa'l-Layla, no. 22, Ibn as-Sunni, no. 69, and al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad; al-'Allamah Ibn Baz graded it hasan in Tuhfat al-Akhyar, p. 26

items.ar: أصبحنا وأصبح الملك لله رب العالمين  ، اللهم إني أسألك خير هذا اليوم  : فتحه، ونصره ،ونوره ،وبركته، وهداه، وأعوذ بك من شر ما فيه وشر ما بعده
items.text: We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its opening, its victory, its light, its blessing and its guidance, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of what is in it and the evil of what follows it.
items.src: Whoever says it seven times in the morning and in the evening, Allah will suffice him in whatever concerns him of the affairs of this world and the Hereafter. Reported by Ibn as-Sunni, no. 71, as marfu', and by Abu Dawud as mawquf, 4/321; its chain was graded sahih by Shu'ayb and 'Abd al-Qadir al-Arna'ut. See Zad al-Ma'ad 2/376

items.ar: أصبحنا على فطرة الإسلام وعلى كلمة الإخلاص، وعلى دين نبيَّنا محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم وعلى ملَّة أبينا إبراهيم حنيفاً مسلماً وما كان من المشركين
items.text: We have entered the morning upon the fitrah of Islam, upon the word of sincerity, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, who was a monotheist, a Muslim, and was not of the polytheists.
items.src: Abu Dawud and Ibn Majah; see Sahih Ibn Majah 2/332

items.ar: من قال :سبحان الله وبحمده( مائة مرة )
items.text: Whoever says: «Glory be to Allah and with His praise» (one hundred times)
items.src: at-Tirmidhi and Abu Dawud; see Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/142

items.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له ،له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير( عشر مرات)  ( أو مرة واحدة عند الكسل)
items.text: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things competent. (ten times) (or once when feeling lazy)
items.src: Whoever says it three times in the morning and three times in the evening, nothing will harm him. Reported by Abu Dawud 4/323, at-Tirmidhi 5/465, Ibn Majah and Ahmad. See Sahih Ibn Majah 2/332; al-'Allamah Ibn Baz graded its chain hasan in Tuhfat al-Akhyar, p. 39

items.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له ،له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير(مائة مرة إذا أصبح )
items.text: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things competent. (one hundred times in the morning)
items.src: Whoever says it three times in the morning and in the evening, it will be a right upon Allah to please him on the Day of Resurrection. Ahmad 4/337, an-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa'l-Layla, no. 4, Ibn as-Sunni, no. 68, Abu Dawud 4/418 and at-Tirmidhi 5/465; Ibn Baz graded it hasan in Tuhfat al-Akhyar, p. 39

items.ar: سبحان الله وبحمده عدد خلقهِ ورِضَا نفسِهِ وزِنُة عَرشِهِ ومِداد كلماته( ثلاث مرات إذا أصبح )
items.text: Glory be to Allah and with His praise, as many times as the number of His creation, as much as pleases Him, as much as the weight of His Throne and as much as the ink of His words. (three times in the morning)
items.src: al-Hakim, who graded it sahih, and adh-Dhahabi agreed with him, 1/545; see Sahih at-Targhib wa't-Tarhib 1/273

items.ar: اللهم إني أسألك علماً نافعاً ، ورزقاً طيباً ، وعملاً متقبلاً  ( إذا أصبح )
items.text: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision and accepted deeds. (in the morning)
items.src: And in the evening he says: «We have entered the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds»

items.ar: أستغفر الله وأتوب إليه  (مائة مرة في اليوم )
items.text: I seek Allah's forgiveness and repent to Him. (one hundred times a day)
items.src: And in the evening he says: «O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night: its opening, its victory, its light, its blessing and its guidance, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of what is in it and the evil of what follows it»

items.ar: أعوذ بكلمات الله التامات من شر ما خلق ( ثلاث مرات إذا أمسى)
items.text: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created. (three times in the evening)
items.src: Abu Dawud 4/322; its chain was graded hasan by Shu'ayb and 'Abd al-Qadir al-Arna'ut in their verification of Zad al-Ma'ad 2/273

items.ar: اللهم صل وسلم على نبينا محمد  (عشر مرات )
items.text: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad. (ten times)
items.src: And in the evening he says: «We have entered the evening upon the fitrah of Islam»

chapters.title: Remembrance before sleeping

items.ar: يجمع كفيه ثم ينفث فيهما فيقرأ:بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم { قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ*اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ*لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ*وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ} بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم {قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ*مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ*وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ*وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ * وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ } بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم { قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ * مَلِكِ النَّاسِ * إِلَهِ النَّاسِ *مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ * الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ * مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ } ثم يمسح بهما ما استطاع من جسده يبدأبهما على رأسه ووجهه وما أقبل من جسده ( يفعل ذلك ثلاث مرات )
items.text: He cups his palms together, blows lightly into them and recites: «In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Self-Sufficient upon whom all depend. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent.» «In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of that which He created, and from the evil of darkness when it settles, and from the evil of the blowers in knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.» «In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer, who whispers into the breasts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind.» Then he wipes with them as much of his body as he can, beginning with his head, his face and the front of his body. (He does this three times.)
items.src: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 9/62 and Muslim 4/1723

items.ar: { اللّهُ لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ }
items.text: «Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.»
items.src: Whoever recites it when going to bed, a guardian from Allah will remain over him and no devil will come near him until morning. Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 4/487

items.ar: { آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللّهِ وَمَلآئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لاَ نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ * لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللّهُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْراً كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنتَ مَوْلاَنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ }
items.text: «The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so have the believers. All of them have believed in Allah, His angels, His books and His messengers, (saying): “We make no distinction between any of His messengers.” And they say: “We hear and we obey. (We seek) Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the final return.” Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity. It will have (the reward of) what (good) it has earned, and it will bear (the consequence of) what (evil) it has earned. “Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us, and forgive us, and have mercy upon us. You are our Protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.”»
items.src: Whoever recites them at night, they will suffice him. Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 9/94 and Muslim 1/554; the two verses are from Surat al-Baqarah, 285–286

items.ar: باسمك  ربي وضعت جنبي وبك أرفعه إن أمسكت نفسي فارحمها، وإن أرسلتها فاحفظها بما تحفظ به عبادك الصالحين
items.text: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and by You I raise it. If You take my soul, have mercy on it, and if You release it, protect it with that with which You protect Your righteous servants.
items.src: When one of you gets up from his bed and then returns to it, let him dust it off three times with the edge of his lower garment and mention the name of Allah, for he does not know what came onto it after he left it; and when he lies down, let him say: ... (the hadith)

items.ar: اللهم خَلَقْتَ نفسي وأنت توفَّاها لك مماتها ومَحْياها، إن أحييتها فاحفظها وإن أمتها فاغفر لها، اللهم إني أسألك العافية
items.text: O Allah, You created my soul and You take it. To You belong its death and its life. If You keep it alive, protect it, and if You cause it to die, forgive it. O Allah, I ask You for well-being.
items.src: Al-Bukhari 11/126 and Muslim 4/2084

items.ar: اللهم قني  عذابك يوم تبعث عبادك ( ثلاث مرات )
items.text: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants. (Three times)
items.src: Narrated by Muslim 4/2083, and by Ahmad with this wording 2/79

items.ar: باسمِكَ اللهم أموت وأحيا
items.text: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
items.src: When the Messenger ﷺ wanted to sleep, he would place his right hand under his cheek and then say: ... (the hadith)

items.ar: سبحان الله ( ثلاثاً وثلاثين ) والحمد لله ( ثلاثاً وثلاثين ) والله أكبر ( أربعاً وثلاثين )
items.text: Glory be to Allah (thirty-three times), praise be to Allah (thirty-three times), and Allah is the Greatest (thirty-four times).
items.src: Abu Dawud with this wording 4/311; see Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/143

items.ar: اللهم ربَّ السموات السبع،ورب العرش العظيم،ربنا ورب كل شيء، فالق الحب والنوى، ومُنزل التوراة والإنجيل والفرقان، أعوذ بك من شر كل شيء أنت آخذٌ بناصيته،اللهم أنت الأول فليس قبلك شيء،وأنت الآخر فليس بعدك شيء، وأنت الظاهر فليس فوقك شيء، وأنت الباطن فليس دونك شيء، اقض عنا الدَّيْنَ واغننا من الفقر
items.text: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Mighty Throne, our Lord and the Lord of everything, Splitter of the grain and the date-stone, Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel and the Criterion (al-Furqan): I seek refuge in You from the evil of everything whose forelock You hold. O Allah, You are the First, and there is nothing before You; You are the Last, and there is nothing after You; You are the Manifest (az-Zahir), and there is nothing above You; You are the Hidden (al-Batin), and there is nothing beyond You. Settle our debt for us and enrich us so we are free from poverty.
items.src: Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 11/113 and Muslim 4/2083

items.ar: الحمد لله الذي أطعمنا وسقانا وكفانا وآوانا فكم ممن لا كافي له ولا مؤوي
items.text: Praise be to Allah who has fed us, given us drink, sufficed us and given us shelter; for how many are there who have no one to suffice them and no one to give them shelter.
items.src: Whoever says this when going to bed, it will be better for him than a servant. Al-Bukhari (with al-Fath) 7/71 and Muslim 4/2091

items.ar: اللهم عالم الغيب والشهادة، فاطر السموات والأرض، رب كل شيء ومليكه أشهد أن لا إله إلا أنت أعوذ بك من شر نفسي، ومن شر الشيطان وشركه وأن أقترف على نفسي سوءًا أو أجرَّه إلى مسلم
items.text: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of everything, I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own soul, from the evil of Satan and his shirk, and from committing evil against myself or bringing it upon a Muslim.
items.src: Muslim 4/2084

items.ar: يقرأ { ألم } تنزيل السجدة، و { تبارك الذي بيده الملك }
items.text: He recites «Alif Lam Mim. The revelation...» (Surat as-Sajdah) and «Blessed is He in whose hand is the dominion» (Surat al-Mulk).
items.src: Muslim 4/2085

items.ar: اللهم   أسلمت نفسي إليك، وفوضت أمري إليك وألجأت ظهري إليك رهبةً ورغبةً إليك، لا ملجأ ولا منجا منك إلا إليك، آمنت بكتابك الذي أنزلت وبنبيك الذي أرسلت
items.text: O Allah, I submit my soul to You, I entrust my affair to You, and I lean my back upon You, out of fear of You and longing for You. There is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You revealed and in Your Prophet whom You sent.
items.src: Abu Dawud 4/317; see Sahih Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3/142

chapters.title: Supplication when turning over in bed at night

items.ar: لا إله إلا الله الواحد القهار، ربُّ السموات والأرض وما بينهما العزيز الغفار
items.text: There is no god but Allah, the One, the Subduer, Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Almighty, the Oft-Forgiving.
items.src: He says this when he turns from one side to the other during the night. Reported by al-Hakim, who graded it authentic, and adh-Dhahabi agreed with him 1/540; also by an-Nasa'i in «al-Yawm wa al-Layla» and Ibn as-Sunni. See al-Albani, «Sahih al-Jami'» 4/213

chapters.title: Supplication for anxiety and fear during sleep, and for one afflicted with loneliness
chapters.titleAr: دعاء القلق والفزع في النوم ومن بلي بالوحشة

items.ar: أعوذ بكلمات الله التَّامَّة من غضبه وعقابه، وشر عباده، ومن همزات الشياطين وأنْ يحضرون
items.text: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and His punishment, from the evil of His servants, from the promptings of the devils and from their presence.
items.src: Abu Dawud 4/12; see Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/171

chapters.title: What to do upon seeing a good dream or a bad dream
chapters.titleAr: ما يفعل من رأى الرؤيا أو الحلم

items.ar: ينفث عن يساره ( ثلاثاً )
items.text: He spits lightly to his left (three times).
items.src: Muslim 4/1772

items.ar: يستعيذ بالله من الشيطان ومن شر ما رأى ( ثلاث مرات )
items.text: He seeks refuge in Allah from Satan and from the evil of what he saw (three times).
items.src: Muslim 4/1773

items.ar: لا يحدث بها أحدا ً
items.text: He does not tell anyone about it.
items.src: Muslim 4/1772

items.ar: يتحول عن جنبه الذي كان عليه
items.text: He turns over from the side he was lying on.
items.src: Muslim 4/1773

items.ar: يقوم يصلي إن أراد ذلك
items.text: He gets up and prays, if he wishes.
items.src: Muslim 4/1773

chapters.title: The Qunut supplication in the Witr prayer

items.ar: اللهم اهدني فيمن هديت ، وعافني فيمن عافيت ، وتولني فيمن توليت ، وبارك لي فيما أعطيت ، وقني شر ما قضيت ، فإنك تقضي ولا يقضى عليك ، إنه لا يذل من واليت ،[ ولا يعز من عاديت ] تباركت ربنا وتعاليت
items.text: O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, grant me well-being among those You have granted well-being, take me into Your care among those You have taken into Your care, bless me in what You have given, and protect me from the evil of what You have decreed. For You decree and none decrees over You. Indeed, the one You befriend is never humiliated, [and the one You take as an enemy is never honoured]. Blessed are You, our Lord, and Exalted.
items.src: Reported by the authors of the four Sunan, Ahmad, ad-Darimi, al-Hakim and al-Bayhaqi; what is between the square brackets is from al-Bayhaqi. See Sahih at-Tirmidhi 1/144, Sahih Ibn Majah 1/194 and al-Albani, «Irwa' al-Ghalil» 2/172

items.ar: اللهم إني أعوذ برضاك من سخطك وأعوذ بمعافاتك من عقوبتك ، وأعوذ بك منك لا أحصي ثناء عليك ، أنت كما أثنيت على نفسك
items.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your displeasure, and in Your pardon from Your punishment, and I seek refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise; You are as You have praised Yourself.
items.src: Reported by the authors of the four Sunan and Ahmad. See Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/180, Sahih Ibn Majah 1/194 and «al-Irwa'» 2/175

items.ar: اللهم إياك نعبد ، ولك نُصلي ونسجد ، وإليك نسعى ونحفدُ ، نرجُو رحمتك ، ونخشى عذابك ، إن عذابك بالكافرين ملحق ، اللهم إنا نستعينك ، ونستغفرك ، ونثني عليك الخير ، ولا نكفرك ، ونؤمن بك ونخضع لك ، ونخلع من يكفرك
items.text: O Allah, You alone we worship, to You we pray and prostrate, and toward You we hasten and strive. We hope for Your mercy and fear Your punishment; indeed Your punishment will overtake the disbelievers. O Allah, we seek Your help and Your forgiveness, we praise You with all good, we do not disbelieve in You, we believe in You and submit to You, and we disown whoever disbelieves in You.
items.src: Reported by al-Bayhaqi in «as-Sunan al-Kubra», who graded its chain authentic 2/211. Shaykh al-Albani said in «Irwa' al-Ghalil»: «This chain is authentic» 2/170. It is a statement of 'Umar (mawquf)

chapters.title: Remembrance after the salam of the Witr prayer

items.ar: كان رسول الله صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يقرأ في الوتر :( سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى ) و ( وَقُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ ) و ( وَقُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ). فإذا سلم قال  سبحان الملك القدوس [ رب الملائكة والروح ] ثلاث مرات والثالثة يجهر بها ويمد بها صوته
items.text: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to recite in the Witr: «Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High», «Say: O disbelievers» and «Say: He is Allah, the One». When he gave the salam, he would say: «Glory be to the King, the Most Holy» [Lord of the angels and the Spirit] three times, saying it aloud the third time and drawing out his voice with it.
items.src: Reported by an-Nasa'i 3/244, ad-Daraqutni and others; what is between the square brackets is an addition of ad-Daraqutni 2/31, and its chain is authentic. See «Zad al-Ma'ad», edited by Shu'ayb al-Arna'ut and 'Abd al-Qadir al-Arna'ut 1/337

chapters.title: Supplication for worry and grief

items.ar: اللهم إني عبدك ابن عبدك ابن أمتك ناصيتي بيدك،ماضِ في حكمك ، عدل في قضاؤك ،أسألك بكل اسم هو لك سميت به نفسك أو أنزلته في كتابك ، أو علمته أحداً من خلقك أو استأثرت به في علم الغيب عندك أن تجعل القرآن ربيع قلبي ، ونور صدري ،وجلاء حزني وذهاب همي
items.text: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand; Your judgment over me is ever executed, and Your decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every name that is Yours, with which You have named Yourself, or revealed in Your Book, or taught to any of Your creation, or kept to Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Qur'an the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the removal of my grief and the departure of my worry.
items.src: Ahmad 1/391; graded authentic by al-Albani

items.ar: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الهم والحزن ، والعجز والكسل والبخل والجبن ، وضلع الدين وغلبة الرجال
items.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by men.
items.src: Al-Bukhari 7/158. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to make this supplication often

chapters.title: Supplication in times of distress

items.ar: لا إله إلا الله العظيم الحليم ، لا إله إلا الله رب العرش العظيم ، لا إله إلا الله رب السموات ورب العرش الكريم
items.text: There is no god but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the Noble Throne.
items.src: Al-Bukhari 7/154 and Muslim 4/2092

items.ar: اللهم رحمتك أرجو فلا تكلني إلى نفسي طرفة عين ِ وأصلح لي شأني كله لا إله إلا أنت
items.text: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye, and set right all my affairs. There is no god but You.
items.src: Abu Dawud 4/324 and Ahmad 5/42; graded hasan by al-Albani in «Sahih Abi Dawud» 3/959

items.ar: لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين
items.text: There is no god but You; glory be to You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
items.src: At-Tirmidhi 5/529, and al-Hakim, who graded it authentic, and adh-Dhahabi agreed with him 1/505. See Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/168

items.ar: الله الله ربي لا أشرك به شيئاً
items.text: Allah, Allah is my Lord; I do not associate anything with Him.
items.src: Reported by Abu Dawud 2/87. See Sahih Ibn Majah 2/335

chapters.title: Supplication upon meeting an enemy or a person of authority

items.ar: اللهم إنا نجعلك في نحورهم ونعوذ بك من شرورهم
items.text: O Allah, we place You before them (at their throats), and we seek refuge in You from their evils.
items.src: Abu Dawud 2/89; graded authentic by al-Hakim, and adh-Dhahabi agreed with him 2/142

items.ar: اللهم أنت عضُدي وأنت نصيري ، بك أحولُ ،وبك أصولُ ، وبك أُقاتلُ
items.text: O Allah, You are my support and You are my helper; by You I move, by You I attack, and by You I fight.
items.src: Abu Dawud 3/42 and at-Tirmidhi 5/572. See Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3/183

items.ar: حسبنا الله ونعم الوكيل
items.text: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
